public_definitions: The task requires identifying the category with the 'highest current labeled rating share' from the dashboard.
The 'labeled rating share' refers to the percentage values (e.g., 24%, 10%) printed above each data point, not the 'Value' axis position.
The goal is to select the option corresponding to this category from the list: 'Select Design', 'Select Quality', 'Select Support'.
uncertain: The 'Other' category has a data label of '32%', but it is not one of the selectable options provided in the task.

The 'Value' axis (y-axis) numbers (e.g., 60 for Quality, 5 for Price) do not match the 'labeled rating share' percentages (e.g., 24% for Quality, 10% for Price). The task explicitly directs to use the 'labeled rating-share values'.
